openwrt_wiki.Beschreibung: ZTE MF286R is a wireless LTE router, capable of connecting to LTE networks at download speeds up to 300Mbps using carrier aggegation. It has 3x3 2.4GHz Wi-Fi 4 and 2x2 5GHz Wi-Fi 5 Wave 2 radios, four gigabit ethernet ports, one USB 2.0 port, two RJ-11 ports for connecting landline phones that lets you use the cellular network to make calls. It is commonly used by some European ISPs for FWA(Fixed Wireless Access) services, such as Windtre on Italy, Turkcell on Türkiye, and more. Some models of the MF286 family include battery or phone ports, as well as corresponding LEDs on the front.
openwrt_wiki.Hinweis Modem: Note: the LTE modem installed in this router is not very stable and can crash, requiring a reboot of the router (e.g. with watchcat).
openwrt_wiki.Installation TL;DR: Get a serial adapter and connect to the serial, boot the initramfs image, then apply the sysupgrade image.
openwrt_wiki.Installation Wege: STEP 3 Method 1: serial console + U-Boot tftpboot (RECOMMENDED), U-Boot erwartet TFTP-Server 192.168.0.22; Method 2: initramfs als temporärer Kernel aus Stock-Firmware; Method 3: built-in TFTP recovery (LAST RESORT), root_uImage, TFTP-Server 192.0.0.1/8. Keine Notfall-TFTP-Sequenz per Knopf.
openwrt_wiki.Basic configuration: LTE-Modem per luci-proto-ncm / proto ncm, device /dev/ttyACM0
openwrt_wiki.Switch Ports: Numbers 0-3 are Ports 1-4 as labeled on the unit, number 4 is the Internet (WAN) on the unit, 5 is the internal connection to the router itself. Tabelle mit EXAMPLE-Werten (FIXME). Beispielkonfiguration "Tested on MF286R": WAN auf eth0.2, VLAN 1 ports '1 2 3 0t', VLAN 2 ports '5 0t'.

Buttons.Power switch: Turns off the power. Although it looks like a hardwired power switch, it might not be so, since sometimes some LEDs stay on even after taking the switch to the off position.

openwrt_wiki.Photos: Front/Back MF286R (superbox), übrige Fotos (Top, Right, Label, Disassembled, PCB) von MF286D
openwrt_wiki.Opening the case: Take of battery lid (no battery support for this model, battery cage is dummy). Unscrew screw placed behind battery lid. Take off back cover (plastic clamps). Unscrew four more screws hidden behind back case. Remove front panel from blue chassis. Unscrew two boards, which secures the PCB in the chassis. Extract board from blue chassis.
openwrt_wiki.Serial: The serial console connections are identical to the ZTE MF286D (remember to connect TX to RX and RX to TX when using the CP2102 USB to UART adapter). DO NOT connect the 3.3V line unless your serial adapter needs it. CH340-based converters output garbage during U-boot; use 117200 in putty; 'CH340 uses 118200 during Uboot and 115200 after bootm'. Serial connection parameters: 115200, 8N1, 3.3V
Quirks: CH340-based USB-UART converters output garbage during U-boot phase; CP2102 works. (CH340 use 118200 during uboot and switch to 115200 after bootm)
FT232RL USB was unable to trigger the 'Interrupt boot sequence by pressing any key'. Use CH340 or CP2102.
Kernel partition size is increased to 4MB compared to stock 3MB.
The only usable LED as a "system LED" is the blue debug LED hidden inside the case. All other LEDs are controlled by modem, on which the router part has some influence only on Wi-Fi LED.
Wi-Fi LED currently doesn't work while under OpenWrt, despite having correct GPIO mapping.
GPIO5 used for modem reset is a suicide switch, causing a hardware reset of whole board, not only the modem.
The same modem module is used as in older MF286.

openwrt_git.Beschreibung: ZTE MF286A and MF286R are indoor LTE category 6/7 CPE router with simultaneous dual-band 802.11ac plus 802.11n Wi-Fi radios and quad-port gigabit Ethernet switch, FXS and external USB 2.0 port.
openwrt_git.NOR Flash: MX25L1606E 2MB SPI Flash, for U-boot only
openwrt_git.NAND Flash: W25N01GV 128MB SPI NAND-Flash, for all other data
openwrt_git.Switch: QCA8337v2 4-port gigabit Ethernet, with single SGMII CPU port
openwrt_git.WWAN: [MF286A] MDM9230-based category 6 internal LTE modem; [MF286R] PXA1826-based category 7 internal LTE modem in extended mini-PCIE form factor, with 3 internal antennas and 2 external antenna connections, single mini-SIM slot.
openwrt_git.FXS: one external ATA port (handled entirely by modem part) with two physical connections in parallel
openwrt_git.Switches: power switch, WPS, Wi-Fi and reset buttons
openwrt_git.LEDs: Wi-Fi, Test (internal). Rest of LEDs (Phone, WWAN, Battery, Signal state) handled entirely by modem. 4 link status LEDs handled by the switch on the backside.
openwrt_git.Battery: 3Ah 1-cell Li-Ion replaceable battery, with charging and monitoring handled by modem.
openwrt_git.Abgrenzung: The device shares many components with previous model, MF286, differing mostly by a Wave2 5GHz radio, flash layout and internal LED color. MF286R uses a different modem based on Marvell PXA1826 chip.
openwrt_git.Modem-Unterstützung: MF286R modem isn't fully supported, but it is expected to use comgt-ncm for connection
openwrt_git.Console connection: connector X2 is the console port, with the following pinout, starting from pin 1, which is the topmost pin when the board is upright: VCC (3.3V). Do not use unless you need to source power for the converer from it. - TX - RX - GND. Default port configuration in U-boot as well as in stock firmware is 115200-8-N-1.
openwrt_git.Installation: sysupgrade from within stock firmware is impossible (different flash layout); Wege: serielle Konsole + U-Boot-TFTP (empfohlen), initramfs aus Stock-Firmware, eingebautes TFTP-Recovery (letzter Ausweg)
openwrt_git.Varianten-Hinweis: Differences [in /proc/mtd] might indicate that this is NOT a MF286A device but one of other variants.
openwrt_git.Quirks: CH340 garbage in U-boot; kernel partition 4MB statt 3MB; einzige nutzbare System-LED ist die blaue Debug-LED im Gehäuse; WLAN-LED unter OpenWrt ohne Funktion; GPIO5 (Modem-Reset) setzt die ganze Platine zurück
